items.title: Atlas Station
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The deep-space station Atlas has gone quiet. You and a small team have arrived to see
what has happened to it. With limited supplies... Can you restore the station and make it
liveable again?

-Roleplay as a space explorer
-Set up a cool base and survive in outer space!
-Marvel at the custom made skybox

items.title: Magic Skies Desert
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this desert-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Hop on this adventure up high. Find creative ways to navigate through the islands. Collect resources and watch your step! Become a master of the skies.

-Desert themed environment.
-Collect loot on various islands.
-Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!

items.title: Magic Skies End
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take yourself to the skies in this End-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Its your life mission to find & slay the Ender Dragon! Somewhere on these islands is the End Portal and all the "keys" needed to open it. Explore, survive and overcome!

-Challenging End inspired environment.
-Find a way to open the end portal.
-Collect loot along the way!

items.title: Magic Skies Forest
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this forest-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Venture your way through the floating forest, explore its secrets and caves, collect resources on the different islands and survive!

-Peaceful forest environment.
-Collect loot on various islands.
-Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!

items.title: Magic Skies Nether
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this Nether-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Experience the fiery desolate scenery while exploring the islands for loot. Visibility is low so watch your step! Can you survive?

-Dangerous & challenging nether environment.
-Collect loot on various islands.
-Explore on your own or with friends!

items.title: Magic Skies Ocean
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this ocean-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Take a dive into the oceanic themed scenery as you explore this cluster of magical sky islands, collect resources from each island and survive!

-Ocean inspired aesthetic.
-Collect loot on various islands.
-Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!

items.title: Magic Skies Canyon
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this canyon-themed skyblock world of magical floating islands! Hop on this adventure up high. Find creative ways to navigate through the islands. Collect resources and watch your step!

- Canyon & mesa themed environment.
- Collect loot on various islands.
- Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!

items.title: Lucky Block
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Lucky Block is the classic mystery block breaking survival game! Break open a yellow lucky block and see if its a good or negative outcome! This world is more fun when you invite a friend to play with you!

+ Giant village
+ Survival with a fun twist

By: ChewMingo

items.title: Pink Perfection!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Do you love the color pink? The Pink Perfection! skin pack is perfect for you. Show off your style with these super epic outfits!

+ Colorful skins
+ Custom fit
+ By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Cute Medieval Town
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome, traveler! Are you ready to explore this cute medieval town and make yourself at home? Look around the cozy houses where you can sleep after all that traveling! 

- Awesome tavern, huge town hall, lots of cool houses, and many more!
- Very cute bee farm
- Relaxing vibes
- Licensed by UniDesigns and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Dog Island
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
Explore the world of Dog Island! Adopt your very own puppy to train and adventure with! Complete quests to find more dogs! Teach your pet tricks, feed them treats, and level them up! Collect puppies together with friends and roleplay as trainers.

Features:
- Complete achievements to earn stars
- Collect up to 13 unique dogs!
- Suitable for regular survival!

items.title: Axolotl Friends
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Hey! Have you ever played with an axolotl? These little monsters are here to play with you!

- 35 cute axolotl skins
- 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & Cordi Studios

items.title: Luxury Anime Teen
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you like anime and manga? With Luxury Anime Teen, show the world how cool and unique you are! Become your favorite character and show off your fashion sense on any server!

- 15 trendy skins!
- 1 free skin!
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & MrKanar

items.title: Demon Party
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Demon teens are having an underground party tonight! Pick a top-notch outfit and enjoy the party.

- 21 skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Rockstar Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Rockstar teens will be back to school and they are looking for new team members. It is your chance now to join them and rock it!

- 21 epic skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Rainbow Style
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Rainbow style has made its way to the top magazines of the fashion industry! Pick your outfit and you shall be in the spotlight everywhere you go!

- 21 cool colorful skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Realistic Textures HD
items.creator: Square Dreams
items.description:
Make your worlds more REALISTIC and IMMERSIVE with HD textures and CUSTOM 3D MODELS! 

+ Realistic custom animals and other mob models!
+ 32x32 HD textures and a custom UI
+ Made for both creative and survival
+ Works in ANY world!

Made by toby109tt and Square Dreams
items.changelog:
Updated for The Copper Age!

+ Added Vibrant Visuals Compatibility
+ Many Updated and Improved Textures
+ Smaller Bugfixes

items.title: Sky Monster: Giant Snake
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: In the ancient times, a giant snake created its own kingdom in the middle of desert floating islands, explore all its secrets and discover the secret entrances!

items.title: Horror Hoodies
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Picture an amazing and fun night celebrating all the creepy things lurking in the night with your friends. What's missing from this otherwise perfect scenario you ask? I am so glad you asked! You need a horror themed hoodie! Something that screams both fashion and scary! Come on by and try one of these spooky sweaters!

items.title: Pro Glitch
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Are you a pro? Do you like exploiting glitches? Maybe you like that dark and mysterious look with a dash of color? Join this super star cast of professionals and take your gameplay to the next level. Who knows, you could be the next viral sensation!

items.title: One Block Original
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you a pro Minecraft gamer? Then try this hardcore challenge and attempt to finish the game and beat the Enderdragon with limited resources!

- The original One Block experience!
- The End and the Nether dimension are also one block!
- Floating air balloons scattered around to explore!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion & Frostlyy

items.title: Socksfor1 Friends
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Meet famous YouTuber Socksfor1 and his best friends!
It's your lucky day, you're able to join their ultimate squad, today!

+ 10 skins, providing you with Socksfor1's finest Minecraft team!
+ Featuring Socksfor1, Nadwe, MrBlaza, TbhHonest & Joocie!

items.title: Fruity Fashion
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Time to start a new fashion trend! Choose from 12 different fruity skins to help you look a little like your favorite healthy snack. Dress up in outfits with seeds and skins in awesome colors. Role-play in super stylish clothes that celebrate Mother Nature’s best food.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Mob Mask Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Give off just a hint of the mob inside of you! Choose from 12 unique skins with marvelous mob masks. Role-play as a teen in super stylin’ outfits and fearsome face disguise. Get ready to cover up and show everyone another side of you!

1 free skin included!
